name: ckam-release-9c95b1f
purpose: CKAM release: closed ERP POs can be shown in Pick from ERP (off by default); Asset 360 says a part was bought as part of a set; the Barcode field is called ERP Barcode; brands say which work areas they are used for; Add Assets asks Where do they go (store / site / stock room); an ERP Barcode typed by hand is checked against the Item (or LOCAL)
release_sha_note: release_sha / release_sha_short repeat release_commit / release_commit_short because ops/windows/deploy_ckam.ps1.template reads these two names to check that the package is the release it was asked to deploy
built_from: git archive of the committed tree 9c95b1f (no working-tree or untracked files)
frontend_build: npm ci; VITE_APP_VERSION=9c95b1f npm run build; npm run check:build
database_change: ONE additive migration: b3d5f7a9c1e4 adds the column brand.work_areas (varchar[], default both IT and NON_IT) and fills each brand from where it is already used (Items that default to it, its assets, its PO lines); a brand used nowhere stays in both areas. No brand, code, name or Item link changes. The database moves from a9c1e3b5d7f2.

migration_notes.rollback: The previous release bdab644 does not know the new column but ignores it (the column has a default), so it can be started again from its release folder if this release must go back; the column may stay. Never start 3b5e842 or older.
migration_notes.never: Never start release 3b5e842 or older: it has the IF-01 file-read hole.

zip_sha256: not stored inside the zip: see MANIFEST.9c95b1f.sha256.txt next to the zip
